description: Forwarding client for the Labreador calculators: fit ELISA standard curves (4PL/5PL) with optional sample interpolation, compute dietary exposure risk indices (EDI, THQ, HI, cancer risk) for food contaminants, and compute pollution indices (contamination factor, geoaccumulation, Pollution Load Index) for a sample. One bin serves a small CLI and the MCP server.
name: @reneturcios/assaycalc
